universal_lens: The DTC Ads Engine formalizes a constrained compositional mapping from a high-dimensional semantic prompt space to a rigidly branded visual manifold. The mandatory ad format acts as a topological anchor, while optional avatars and products serve as conditional perturbations within a strictly bounded generative Hilbert space.
gsi_mapping: In GSI Bayesian inference, the mandatory `format_id` establishes a strict prior distribution over visual layouts. gse_mapping: Within GSE situational reasoning, the generation workflow is modeled as a discrete state-transition system. primitives.verbatim_quote: ## End-to-end flow There is no fixed order, but **picking an ad format is mandatory** — both the CLI and the server reject calls without `format_id`.
primitives.assumptions: The generative manifold requires a fixed structural skeleton to ensure dimensional consistency of the output image.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System singularity occurs if format_id is undefined or absent, causing immediate rejection by the CLI/server boundary conditions.

primitives.name: Conditional Asset Embedding Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Everything else (brand kit, avatar, product, media) is optional and only applied when the user explicitly provides them.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: asset_vector: High-dimensional embedding vector (dimensionless latent space coordinates).
primitives.assumptions: Optional assets function as sparse additive vectors that do not fundamentally alter the base topology defined by the format.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Embedding collision or severe stylistic drift if provided assets possess orthogonal feature distributions relative to the brand kit.

layer2.mapping: Maps to injecting dynamic player telemetry or environmental variables into a static game-simulation kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Latent space distance between generated output and provided reference media.

primitives.name: Asynchronous Rendering Poll Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Generate.** With `--wait`, the command polls until the job completes and prints the result URL.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: Continuous time variable (seconds). status(t): Discrete state indicator (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: The rendering backend operates as a non-deterministic finite automaton with bounded processing latency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Timeout singularity if the polling interval exceeds the maximum allowed wait threshold (`--timeout`).

layer2.telemetry: Average job completion latency and timeout exception rates.

reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical anti-collinearity veto must exist between the chosen format topology and the injected asset embeddings. If a user attempts to map a highly complex, multi-layered product image into a minimalist, text-heavy headline format, the resulting feature vectors will clash violently, leading to semantic degradation. The system must detect this cross-layer leakage—where asset dimensions exceed format capacity—and abort the generation sequence before wasting computational resources on a doomed rendering job.
